name: Sarumaru Inuyoshi
source:
A man who runs a dubious crepe shop from a classic German wagon.
He often laughs eerily and behaves like a clown, but he is also a great romanticist.
He is an elusive handsome man who not interested in women.
In his shop Inuyoshi sells everything, tangible and intangible, from things to people. His creed is that the world will never be the same.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=933594&gc=gc]Getchu[/url].]
